page_title: COM 3-1 VER | Como v Verona 29/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+4' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Gift Orban (Verona).
90+2' 3 - 1 Goal! After receiving a sweet pass, Mergim Vojvoda (Como) unleashes a shot straight into the bottom left corner. Good team effort!
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' We are about to witness a subsitution. Ivan Smolcic (Como) for Maxence Caqueret.
89' Cesc Fabregas has decided to make a change. Alvaro Morata (Como) replaces Anastasios Douvikas.
87' The referee allows time for a substitution. Martin Frese will be replaced by Daniel Mosquera (Verona).
86' Amin Sarr (Verona) picks up the rebound just a few yards out of the box. He attempts to beat the goalkeeper with a fine shot, but the goalkeeper is on hand to deny him.
85' Nico Paz (Como) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
84' Como seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.

81' Verona slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
80' Anastasios Douvikas (Como) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
78' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Stefan Posch walks off the pitch to be replaced by Marc Oliver Kempf (Como).
78' Cesc Fabregas has decided to substitute Nicolas-Gerrit Kuhn and he is replaced by Mergim Vojvoda (Como).
78' Jesus Rodriguez (Como) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
75' The substitution is prepared. Amin Sarr (Verona) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Roberto Gagliardini.

74' Giovane (Verona) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball.

72' Maxence Caqueret (Como) gets to the ball on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot on goal, but the ball curls just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Verona will have a goal kick.
71' Wonderful movement by Como. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
68' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Cheikh Niasse (Verona) is coming onto the pitch as Suat Serdar cannot continue after picking up an injury.
68' Paolo Zanetti decides to make a substitution. Nicolas Valentini (Verona) will be replaced by Domagoj Bradaric.
67' Como keep possession of the ball by producing one-two passes, but an opponent steps in and wins the ball. The linesman signals a throw-in for Como.

64' Como slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
62' 2 - 1 It's a goal! Maxence Caqueret sends a long raking pass onto the head of Stefan Posch (Como), who makes no mistake from close in and sends the ball into the left side of the goal. 2:1.
60' Matteo Marcenaro shows a yellow card to Victor Nelsson (Verona), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.

59' Nico Paz (Como) blows a good opportunity. He has a lot of space around him and fires a decent low shot from the edge of the box towards the middle of the net, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
59' Gift Orban (Verona) has a sight of goal, fires a shot in from distance towards the right post and forces a good save out of Jean Butez.
58' Wonderful movement by Como. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
55' The referee gives a yellow card to Nico Paz (Como).
54' Substitution. Assane Diao did his best and is replaced by Jesus Rodriguez (Como).
53' Alex Valle (Como) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
52' Como are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
49' Rafik Belghali (Verona) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
48' Como showcase their great team work by exchanging one-two passes, but one wayward pass sees them lose possession.
46' The game is interrupted. Lucas Da Cunha (Como) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
46' The whistle blows and Matteo Marcenaro starts the second half.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
45' Nico Paz (Como) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.

42' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Como are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
39' Rafik Belghali (Verona) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
37' Assane Diao (Como) is deemed to be in an offside position by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
35' Martin Frese (Verona) takes the corner which is cleared.
34' Giovane (Verona) swings the ball into the box from the corner kick but it's a bit too strong and it goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Como will have a goal kick.
34' Rafik Belghali (Verona) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. Verona force their opponents to concede a corner.

32' Como slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
30' The game is interrupted now, Suat Serdar (Verona) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
29' Giovane (Verona) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle.
27' Roberto Gagliardini (Verona) has tested the patience of referee Matteo Marcenaro and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
25' 1 - 1 Goal! Jean Butez makes a huge mistake and Suat Serdar (Verona) has an easy task to put the ball into the back of the net. 1:1.
24' Victor Nelsson (Verona) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header inches over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Como.
24' Martin Frese (Verona) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
23' Nicolas Valentini (Verona) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players. Verona will take a corner kick.
22' Nicolas-Gerrit Kuhn (Como) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Matteo Marcenaro who sees an offensive foul.
20' Looks like Maxence Caqueret (Como) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
18' Anastasios Douvikas (Como) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball. The ball goes out of play and Verona will have a goal kick.
17' Gift Orban (Verona) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball. The ball is out of play. Como will take a throw-in.
16' Como seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
14' Nico Paz (Como) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
14' Antoine Bernede (Verona) brings his opponent down. Matteo Marcenaro has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. That's a free kick to Como.
12' Wonderful movement by Verona. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
11' Como keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
9' 1 - 0 Anastasios Douvikas (Como) scores from quite a difficult position as he leaps high to connect with a cross and powers his header into the top left corner. Excellent finish.
8' Giovane (Verona) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the middle of the target, but Jean Butez easily deals with the threat.
8' Nico Paz (Como) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
6' Assane Diao (Como) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.

4' Nico Paz (Como) takes the free kick from just outside the box and attempts to convert it into a goal. He hits it magnificently and the keeper must be relieved to see the ball hit the right post and ricochet away. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Verona.
3' Como are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
2' Como have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
2' Nicolas-Gerrit Kuhn (Como) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Como have a corner.
1' Como are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
1' The first half has just begun.
Verona will kick the game off.
Matteo Marcenaro will officiate today.
